title: 美方呼吁欧洲释放柴油库存 缓解全球供应偏紧
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So the work you're doing is more long-term. Obviously, the election is 15 days away.
segments.zh: 所以你们做的工作更偏长期。显然，选举还有15天。

segments.en: There's lots of concerns. You see it in survey after survey about inflation, gasoline, diesel and record prices.
segments.zh: 有很多担忧。你在一次次调查中看到，关于通胀、汽油、柴油和创纪录的价格。

segments.en: What are the levers the administration is thinking about short-term?
segments.zh: 政府短期内正在考虑哪些杠杆？

segments.en: Well, for us, it's all levers. You know, we got to solve the problem with or without an election.
segments.zh: 嗯，对我们来说，所有杠杆都要用。你知道，无论有没有选举，我们都必须解决问题。

segments.en: Of course, you'd love to solve the problem as quickly as possible.
segments.zh: 当然，你希望尽快解决问题。

segments.en: The biggest thing we're working right now, and I'll continue to work later this week, is discussions with the European, our European partners,
segments.zh: 我们目前正在做的最重要的事情，本周晚些时候我也会继续做，就是与欧洲伙伴进行讨论，

segments.en: who actually have very significant diesel stores.
segments.zh: 他们实际上拥有非常大量的柴油储备。

segments.en: They store much more refined products than they store crude.
segments.zh: 他们储存的成品油比原油多得多。

segments.en: They have huge volumes of diesel. And as I said, there are more than 90 days, right?
segments.zh: 他们有大量的柴油。正如我所说，超过90天，对吧？

segments.en: For the Europeans, they have to have 90 days of stockpiles.
segments.zh: 对欧洲人来说，他们必须有90天的库存。

segments.en: Yeah, I would say, yes. But I think several of the countries have well beyond that.
segments.zh: 是的，我会说是的。但我认为有几个国家已经远超这个水平。

segments.en: But you know, this is, if we've never had a shortage of diesel like this one, their reluctance to release stocks, I think, is against their own interest,
segments.zh: 但你知道，如果我们从未遇到过这样的柴油短缺，他们不愿释放库存，我认为这违背了他们自身的利益，

segments.en: and certainly against the interest of the global demand right now.
segments.zh: 而且肯定违背了当前全球需求的利益。

segments.en: So we've got a three alarm fire for diesel, time to release those diesel stocks.
segments.zh: 所以柴油市场已拉响三级警报，是时候释放这些柴油库存了。

segments.en: I've encouraged them to do the same thing we have done with the Strategic Petroleum Reserve, which is don't sell it, swap it.
segments.zh: 我鼓励他们采取我们对待战略石油储备的同样做法，即不要出售，而是互换。

segments.en: You can give a barrel today, and you can get back 1.1 barrels next year.
segments.zh: 你今天可以给出一桶，明年可以拿回1.1桶。

segments.en: You know, they can view their stocks. But right now, the world is very short diesel.
segments.zh: 他们可以这样看待自己的库存。但目前，全球柴油非常短缺。
